releaseNotes.zh:
1. 修复自动更新安装后未自动重启的问题
2. 修复静默安装可能因文件被占用而失败的问题
3. 更新过程现在写入日志（updates/apply_update.log），失败可诊断
releaseNotes.en:
1. Fixed auto-update not relaunching the app after install
2. Fixed silent installer failing on locked files (orphaned child processes now cleaned up)
3. Update process now logs to updates/apply_update.log for diagnosability
